name: Hangzhou Raycloud Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Hangzhou Raycloud Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the provision of SaaS products and value-added services to e-commerce merchants in China. It offers e-commerce SaaS products, supporting hardware, CRM SMS, and operational services. In addition, it provides super store manager, express assistants, prosperous store transactions, super express, follow-up order software. Further, the company offers e-commerce warehousing, customer service, and design intelligent solutions; comprehensive e-commerce promotion solution; and comprehensive solutions for small and medium-sized enterprises. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Hangzhou, China.
